thread:
Nora (People Ops): dropping a tiny 'micro-goal card' format for quick goal-setting + reviewer notes. designed to be pasted into a PR, 1:1, or the calibration doc :sparkles:
Ben (EM): curious  what's on the card? micro fields only pls
Nora (People Ops): Card = Role / Outcome / Signal / Ask. Each one line. Then optional reviewer note (1 line).
Kai (SWE): example pls for a reliability ticket?
Nora (People Ops): Example: Role: SWE II / Outcome: reduce p95 API latency by 30% / Signal: p95 420ms -> 290ms / Ask: need infra review + perf budget slot. Reviewer note: "Good tradeoffs; watch memory overhead"
Ben (EM): love the brevity. can we include a 1-line manager prompt to use in 1:1s?
Nora (People Ops): sure: Manager prompt: "What's the smallest change that moves the signal 20% toward the target? What support removes the blocker?"
OpsBot: reminder: upload new template to goals hub and tag #calibration in 24h (auto)
Kai (SWE): can you add a 2-line self-review blurb for changelogs? keeps things tidy
Nora (People Ops): Self-review blurb (2 lines): "Outcome I owned: <one sentence>. Evidence: <link(s)> + metric delta. Biggest learning: <one short sentence>."
Ben (EM): OK, this is paste-ready. i'll share in my team's channel. thanks Nora :thumbsup:
